title: Reciprocal-Manifold Annealed KKT Flows for Constrained Optimization: Application to the Nonconvex AC Optimal Power Flow
summary: Safety-critical optimization applications, such as real-time power system operation, maintain feasibility at every intermediate step, not merely at convergence. Existing approaches either violate constraints mid-solve (interior-point methods) or enforce feasibility through per-instant quadratic programming subproblems with cubic computational cost and unbounded worst-case execution time.
